description: Edit PDF files: merge, extract, delete, rotate, reorder, split, compress (lossless), protect (set password), unlock (remove password), replace_text (edits the text in place, font kept), redact (removes what is under boxes or every occurrence of find: the page is redrawn as a picture, so the text is gone from the file, then checked). Page numbers are 1-based.

allowCopy.description: protect: allow copying text. Default true

at.description: split: page numbers that start a new file, e.g. [4,8] makes 1-3, 4-7, 8-end

boxes.description: redact: areas to remove, in points from the top-left of the page as displayed (A4 is 595 x 842)

find.description: replace_text: exact text, case sensitive. redact: a phrase or a list of phrases to remove wherever the text layer has them

order.description: reorder: full new page order, e.g. [3,1,2]

out.description: Absolute output path. split: output directory

ownerPassword.description: protect: separate owner password. Default same as password

pages.description: extract, delete, rotate, replace_text: pages to act on. Default all

password.description: protect: password to set. unlock: password to remove. others: password of an encrypted input

paths.description: Absolute paths. merge takes several files, every other op takes one

replace.description: replace_text: new text, one line. Empty deletes

name: pdf_edit
title: Edit PDF
